citation: Shi K, Xiao H, Taleb S, Flores-Ruiz FJ, Acuautla M. High-Performance of Piezoelectric and Ferroelectric PVDF-TrFE Based Composites Engineered by MWCNTs@BaTiO3 Heterostructure. Small 21(45), e08878 (2025).
license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), open access; PDF from the PMC open-access subset (PMC12614141). Non-commercial academic reuse of digitized values with citation.
figure: Fig. 4c (PDF p. 9, image xref 137, 2051x1559 px, panel c at x 1400-2051, y 0-520)
device: solution-cast PVDF-TrFE composite films, silver-paste electrodes, poled at 1000 kV/cm; loads applied by an Instron universal testing machine at 0.2 Hz, load resistance 60 MOhm
quantity: peak output voltage (V) during the load-release half cycle, as plotted
coding: model inputs mirror the paper's (c, is_pristine): c = filler_wt_pct = MWCNTs@BaTiO3 loading; pristine PVDF-TrFE is c = 0, is_pristine = 1; PB-5 (5 wt% BaTiO3, no MWCNT) is c = 0, is_pristine = 0, exactly as PVDF/BaTiO3 in the paper's grid (c = 0 wt% CNT, is_pristine = 0); bto_wt_pct records the BaTiO3 of PB-5 but is not a model input

repeat_pass.description: second pass with a looser colour threshold, darker highlight cut and narrower column window

second_figure_PBC5.description: PBC-5 curve read a second time, independently, from the Fig. 4b waveform (median pulse peak per force band)

digitization_error.occlusion_note: partly hidden markers read from one visible edge plus the radius; reading method per row in the csv column 'reading'
